title: AI Voices 每日精选
subtitle: 研究者公开观点、研究发布与重要讨论。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: @polynoamial：LLMs have crossed an important threshold: surpassing top human experts on some research problems. Capabilities have been
items.abstract_or_text: LLMs have crossed an important threshold: surpassing top human experts on some research problems. Capabilities have been steadily improving for years, but in scientific discovery there is a big difference between a model just below top human performance and one just above it. That helps explain why the surge in math results feels so sudden. LLM capabilities remain jagged, and there are many ways they are still worse than humans. But as models continue to improve, I expect breakthroughs in other domains to follow, leading to a new era of scientific discovery.
items.summary_zh: Noam Brown 认为，大语言模型已在部分研究问题上超过顶尖人类专家；他同时强调模型能力仍不均衡，数学领域的突破可能预示其他科学领域的进展。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是对科学发现拐点的研究者判断，既指出性能跨过关键阈值，也明确提醒读者不要忽视模型能力的“短板”。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型已经跨过一个重要门槛：在一些研究问题上超过顶尖人类专家。多年来能力稳步提升，但在科学发现中，模型从略低于顶尖人类表现到略高于它之间存在巨大差异。这有助于解释数学结果为何感觉突然激增。大语言模型的能力仍然参差不齐，在许多方面仍不如人类。但随着模型继续改进，我预计其他领域也会出现突破，开启科学发现的新纪元。

items.title: @IsomorphicLabs：Previously, 85% of proteins associated with human disease were deemed intractable – their shapes and function made them
items.abstract_or_text: Previously, 85% of proteins associated with human disease were deemed intractable – their shapes and function made them less suitable for traditional chemical screening in the lab. Moving from experimental screening to AI generative design on a computer, we have seen these targets drastically open up the potential to design molecules with atomic precision, fundamentally expanding the number of diseases we can treat.
items.summary_zh: Isomorphic Labs 表示，过去约 85% 的疾病相关蛋白被视为难以开展传统化学筛选；其帖文称，AI 生成式分子设计正在扩大这些靶点的可开发空间。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 帖文提出了 AI 设计分子从结构预测走向药物化学应用的方向，但 85% 和治疗范围扩大的说法仍应视为机构自述，不能替代独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 过去，与人类疾病相关的蛋白质中有 85% 被认为难以处理——它们的形状和功能使其不太适合在实验室进行传统化学筛选。我们从实验筛选转向计算机上的 AI 生成式设计后，看到这些靶点的潜力大幅打开，能够以原子级精度设计分子，从根本上扩展可治疗疾病的范围。

items.title: @pushmeet：Building predictive biology models is one of the most important scientific challenges of our time, but solving this requ
items.abstract_or_text: Building predictive biology models is one of the most important scientific challenges of our time, but solving this requires new experimental biological data at an unprecedented scale. I’m pleased to announce that @GoogleDeepmind is partnering with @ChanZuckerberg’s Virtual Biology Initiative to create the multi-modal datasets needed for improved predictive biology models. I wrote recently about the need to discover how life works at many different scales, from DNA and individual proteins to living cells and whole-body health. As we learnt from AlphaFold and the Protein Data Bank, solving grand biological challenges will not be possible without high-quality open data and efforts like the @czbiohub initiative. Read the announcement here: https://t.co/RwWzG765lh And my previous essay here: https://t.co/3YzWDCEVNp @AllenInstitute, @BroadInstitute, @GladstoneInst, @humancellatlas, @ProteinAtlas, @sangerinstitute, @IsomorphicLabs, @Meta
items.summary_zh: Pushmeet Kohli 宣布 Google DeepMind 与 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative 的 Virtual Biology Initiative 合作，建设用于预测生物学的多模态实验数据集。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预测生物学的瓶颈不仅是模型，也包括跨尺度、高质量、开放的实验数据；这项合作直接针对数据基础设施问题。
items.abstract_zh: 构建预测生物学模型是我们这个时代最重要的科学挑战之一，但解决它需要以前所未有的规模获取新的实验生物学数据。我很高兴地宣布，Google DeepMind 正与 Chan Zuckerberg 的 Virtual Biology Initiative 合作，创建改进预测生物学模型所需的多模态数据集。我最近写过一篇文章，讨论了在多个尺度上发现生命如何运作的必要性，从 DNA 和单个蛋白质，到活细胞和全身健康。正如我们从 AlphaFold 和 Protein Data Bank 学到的那样，没有高质量的开放数据以及 Chan Zuckerberg Biohub 这类倡议的努力，宏大的生物学挑战将无法解决。

items.title: @percyliang：What is the probability that Astra today can generate/forecast a particular new paper past its cutoff date? Naive sampli
items.abstract_or_text: What is the probability that Astra today can generate/forecast a particular new paper past its cutoff date? Naive sampling is intractable (tail probability is astronomically small). The key idea of priced guidance is that you can lower bound this probability via a dialogue between the model (Astra) and a guide LLM (Astra with the paper), where we can precisely account for the bits of information sent from the guide to the model. One can also can think of this as a new eval for frontier models.
items.summary_zh: Percy Liang 介绍一种“定价引导”思路：通过模型与掌握目标论文的引导模型对话，估计 Astra 生成或预测截断日期之后论文的概率，并精确计算传递的信息量。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把前沿模型的未来论文预测转化为可度量的尾部概率与信息成本问题，为评测模型是否真正发现新知识提供了具体方向。
items.abstract_zh: Astra 今天生成或预测某篇截断日期之后的新论文的概率是多少？朴素采样难以处理，因为尾部概率小得天文数字般低。关键思路是定价引导：让模型 Astra 与一个掌握该论文的引导大模型对话，可以给这个概率建立下界，同时精确计算引导模型发送给 Astra 的信息比特数。也可以把它看作前沿模型的一种新评测。

Join Rui Meng at the @COLM_conf Google booth (#107) today at 2:00 PM PT for a live demo of ScientistTwo, an autonomous multi-agent framework that analyzes research papers, identifies limitations, and produces verified codebases. Read the paper:
items.summary_zh: Google Research 介绍 ScientistTwo：一个自主多智能体框架，可分析研究论文、识别局限，并生成经过验证的代码库。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 帖文给出了科研智能体的完整工作链条——文献分析、局限识别和代码验证——比泛泛宣传“自动科研”更具可核查的系统描述。
items.abstract_zh: 自主 AI 能否推动科学发现的前沿？欢迎在 COLM 会议 Google 展台（107 号）参加 Rui Meng 的现场演示，了解 ScientistTwo：一个自主多智能体框架，能够分析研究论文、识别局限，并生成经过验证的代码库。论文链接：

items.title: @skull8888888888：Introducing flow-1, our new model trained with RL to find errors in agent traces. It matches GPT-6-sol in trace intellig
items.abstract_or_text: Introducing flow-1, our new model trained with RL to find errors in agent traces. It matches GPT-6-sol in trace intelligence while being 23x cheaper. It also costs 25% less to run than GPT-6-luna. flow-1 finally makes it possible to monitor and understand every agent run, without sampling. 1/6
items.summary_zh: flow-1 是一个用强化学习训练、用于发现智能体轨迹错误的模型；作者声称其轨迹智能达到 GPT-6-sol 水平，同时成本低 23%，运行成本比 GPT-6-luna 低 25%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把智能体可观测性从抽样检查推进到逐次运行监测，并给出成本对比；性能与成本数字仍需查看完整线程和独立基准。
items.abstract_zh: 介绍 flow-1：这是一个用强化学习训练、用于发现智能体轨迹错误的新模型。它在轨迹智能上匹配 GPT-6-sol，同时成本低 23%。它的运行成本也比 GPT-6-luna 低 25%。flow-1 终于让逐次监测和理解每一次智能体运行成为可能，而无需抽样。1/6

items.title: @allen_ai：Our paper on retrofitting language models to operate over bytes – the approach behind Bolmo – has been accepted to Natur
items.abstract_or_text: Our paper on retrofitting language models to operate over bytes – the approach behind Bolmo – has been accepted to Nature! 🎉 We’re also releasing new checkpoints that extend our method from Olmo to Qwen & Llama. 🧵 https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-11111-4
items.summary_zh: Ai2 宣布其将语言模型改造成字节级操作、并用于 Bolmo 的论文已被 Nature 接收，同时发布扩展到 Qwen 和 Llama 的新检查点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是明确的正式发表与模型更新事件，既提供同行评审进展，也给出可复用的模型检查点。
items.abstract_zh: 我们关于改造语言模型、使其能够处理字节的论文——也是 Bolmo 背后的方法——已被 Nature 接收！我们还发布了新的检查点，把这一方法从 Olmo 扩展到了 Qwen 和 Llama。

items.title: @NVIDIAAI：An AI agent makes a mistake early in a task, then keeps going in the wrong direction. Our researchers built PivotOPD to
items.abstract_or_text: An AI agent makes a mistake early in a task, then keeps going in the wrong direction. Our researchers built PivotOPD to teach agents how to avoid those mistakes and recover when they happen. During training, a teacher model shows the agent a better action and how to get back on track over the next few steps. Read the paper and watch how it works:
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 研究人员提出 PivotOPD，用教师模型在训练时示范更好的动作，并教智能体在早期犯错后恢复到正确轨道。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它针对智能体错误会累积并导致任务持续偏航这一实际问题，给出了训练阶段的纠错与恢复机制。
items.abstract_zh: 智能体在任务早期犯了错误，随后不断沿着错误方向继续执行。我们的研究人员构建了 PivotOPD，教智能体如何避免这些错误，并在错误发生后进行恢复。训练期间，一个教师模型会向智能体展示更好的动作，以及接下来几步如何回到正轨。

items.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: A 3,500-Line Lightweight Agentic RL Framework for Training Agents with Real Harnesses
items.abstract_or_text: Training AI agents with reinforcement learning can be challenging because their tools, context, and decision-making are managed by complex frameworks. Agent Lightning connects existing agents to RL training, making it easier to improve them without rebuilding them. The post Agent Lightning v1.0: A 3,500-Line Lightweight Agentic RL Framework for Training Agents with Real Harnesses appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.summary_zh: Microsoft Research 发布 Agent Lightning v1.0，这是一个约 3500 行的轻量级智能体强化学习框架，可将现有智能体接入 RL 训练，而无需重写。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它降低了把真实工具、上下文和决策框架接入强化学习训练的工程门槛，具有直接的复用价值。
items.abstract_zh: 用强化学习训练 AI 智能体可能很困难，因为它们的工具、上下文和决策由复杂框架管理。Agent Lightning 将现有智能体连接到强化学习训练，使改进这些智能体变得更容易，而无需重新构建它们。

items.title: @ManassehA06：The optimality of the packing for 11 squares has been formalized in lean thanks to Astra and Claude! Huge thanks to @ojo
items.abstract_or_text: The optimality of the packing for 11 squares has been formalized in lean thanks to Astra and Claude! Huge thanks to @ojoshe, @kleddamag, @wand_125, @guzhou0806, and @ctjlewis for aiding in the process. Image credit: https://jlevy.github.io/squares/cases/11.html 1/n
items.summary_zh: 研究者宣布，11 个正方形的装箱最优性已借助 Astra 和 Claude 在 Lean 中完成形式化证明，并感谢协作者参与。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一个具体的 AI 辅助形式化验证案例，展示了模型在数学证明工程中的实际作用；其正确性仍以 Lean 代码和人工审查为准。
items.abstract_zh: 借助 Astra 和 Claude，11 个正方形装箱的最优性已经在 Lean 中完成形式化！非常感谢 @ojoshe、@kleddamag、@wand_125、@guzhou0806 和 @ctjlewis 在过程中提供帮助。图片来源：https://jlevy.github.io/squares/cases/11.html 1/n
